Title: Use existing automation account for automatic updates of the Mobility service

Body.Content:
When configuring automatic updates for the Azure Site Recovery Mobility service extension that runs on Azure VMs enabled for disaster recovery, you can now select an existing automation account to use, instead of using the default account created by Site Recovery. 

Read the detailed documentation.
